limitations: Source-aligned bilingual pairs are not a proof of translation accuracy. No claim of all-human review.
POS and senses checked against licensed source, not an independently licensed bilingual dictionary.
CMU US phonemes converted to broad IPA; stress placement uses maximal onset and variants are retained.
Grammar checks detect repeated tokens/template gaps and target-word usage only; they do not prove all sentences grammatical.
ExampleIndexes link literal Chinese phrases only; missing indices leave examples at word level without guessed sense assignment.
